title: List Imported Numbers Response
description: Response message to list your imported phone numbers

importedNumbers.description: List of numbers associated to the client project specified in `ListImportedNumbers`.

nextPageToken.description: The token to be used for listing the next page.

CampaignProvisioning.description: An object giving details about the campaign provisioning of the number.

campaignProvisioning.description: An object giving details about the campaign provisioning of the number.

serviceId.description: A unique identifier for the service being provisioned.

updateTime.description: A timestamp in ISO 8601 format (UTC) indicating the last time the provisioning status was updated.

errorMessage.description: If an error occurred during provisioning, this field will contain a descriptive message. It will be an empty string if no error is present.

errorCode.description: If an error occurred during provisioning, this field will contain the error code. This field is also an empty string when no error has occurred.

CarrierState.description: Contains information about the state of the carrier.

ErrorCode.description: An optional string field that contains an error code if the operation failed. This field is empty ("") when there is no error.

ErrorMessage.description: An optional string field that provides a human-readable message describing the error. This field is empty ("") when no error has occurred.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number in e.164 format with leading +.

projectId.description: The ID of the project resource. You can find your project ID on dashboard.sinch.com.

regionCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the phone number. Example US, UK or SE.

displayName.description: User supplied name for the phone number.

callbackUrl.description: The client's callback URL to be called upon finishing the number import.

mnoConfiguration.description: The mnoConfiguration object represents the status and progress of configuration operations for SMS and MMS services across different carriers (AT&T and T-Mobile). Each key within this object (smsAtt, smsTmo, mmsAtt and mmsTmo) corresponds to a specific service type (SMS or MMS) associated with a particular mobile network operator.

smsAtt.description: Contains information about SMS-enabled ATT&T numbers.

smsTmo.description: Contains information about SMS-enabled T-Mobile numbers.

mmsAtt.description: Contains information about MMS-enabled AT&T numbers.

mmsTmo.description: Contains information about MMS-enabled T-Mobile numbers.

Operation.description: Specifies the type of action being performed.

x-enumDescriptions.PROVISIONING: The service is being configured or activated.
x-enumDescriptions.DEPROVISIONING: The service is being deactivated or removed.

servicePlanId.description: Service plan of the scheduled provisioning task.

lastUpdatedTime.description: Timestamp when the status was last updated.

campaignId.description: The campaign of the scheduled provisioning task.

errorCodes.description: A list of error codes, if applicable, for the scheduled provisioning task.

servicePlanId.description: The current SMS configuration for this number. The `servicePlanId`` can be found when logging into dashboard.sinch.com in the SMS>APIs section.

campaignId.description: The current campaign ID assigned to this number.

migrateToSinchTmo.description: Displays if a number is assigned to another aggregator in T-Mobile's platform, and requires migration from previous aggregator to Sinch.

SmsProvisioning.description: An object giving details about the SMS provisioning of the number.

smsProvisioning.description: An object giving details about the SMS provisioning of the number.

serviceId.description: A unique identifier for the service being provisioned.

updateTime.description: A timestamp in ISO 8601 format (UTC) indicating the last time the provisioning status was updated.

errorMessage.description: If an error occurred during provisioning, this field will contain a descriptive message. It will be an empty string if no error is present.

errorCode.description: If an error occurred during provisioning, this field will contain the error code. This field is also an empty string when no error has occurred.

State.description: Indicates the current state of the operation.

x-enumDescriptions.IN_PROGRESS: The operation is currently in progress.
x-enumDescriptions.WAITING: The operation is pending and has not yet started.

Type.description: Specifies the type of operation. This value of this field is either "PROVISIONING" or "DEPROVISIONING".

x-enumDescriptions.PROVISIONING: The operation is provisioning the number.
x-enumDescriptions.DEPROVISIONING: The operation is deprovisioning the number.

UpdateTime.description: A timestamp in ISO 8601 format indicating the last time the status was updated.
